skills.name: Composite - Heat-bend PVC conduit
skills.description: Heat a PVC conduit uniformly while rotating it, form the softened section to the required bend, and hold or cool it until the shape is fixed.

steps.activity: Determine the bend locations needed to produce the target shape
Position the heat gun at a bend location on the pvc conduit
Rotate the pvc conduit while heating the bend location uniformly
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

steps.activity: Inspect and test the pvc conduit until it is soft enough to bend
steps.category: Inspect to check state or find issues

steps.activity: Push or pull the softened pvc conduit into the target shape
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Hold or place the formed pvc conduit in the cooling_medium until the bend is fixed

examples: Heat-bend two shallow offsets in PVC conduit for a flush box entry
Form a PVC electrical conduit bend with a heat gun and cool it in water
